review.images: Checked the seven published gallery scenes and the wider hero. Kept seven distinct views after removing the narrower repeated tower scene. The hero supplies the card crop, and the living room and bedroom supply the editorial images.
review.location: The exact project is marked on physical brochure page 5 beside Dubai Hills Park. Verified the four printed estimates and kept the walk and drive distinction. The current official page did not provide a verified project coordinate, so directions use the project and community name.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 18 pages of the official matching PDF, with 15 apartment sheets and two full townhouse sheets. Checked all 23 square-foot panels against an independent text extraction and reviewed differences of 0.01 sq ft on the original sheets.
